current.text: He is a rookie guard for the Rockets, taken in the second round.
In Summer League he averaged 16 points, more than 2.5 steals and 4 assists, and shot 41% from three.
The experts think he can find a rotation role and could help as extra guard depth from opening night. Lloyd thinks he might develop into a real player.
Houston's guard rotation is crowded. Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Marcus Smart, Reed Sheppard and Bogdan Bogdanovic all compete for guard minutes.
Coach Ime Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes, and the roster is thin after the top 10 or 11 players. That leaves few minutes for a reserve guard.
With our March 28 end date, the Rockets have a weak fantasy playoff schedule: 3, 3 and 4 games, so 10 games over the three weeks.

durable.text: He played four years of college basketball. Houston drafted him 31st, the first pick of the second round.
His shooting numbers are elite across the board.
He is undersized for an NBA guard.
